fees.note: Single-trip permit $20 (superload single-trip permit $30). Valid up to 13 days. If the load is also overweight the $20 is shown on the overweight line instead.
Single-trip permit $20 (superload $30), one permit covers weight and dimensions.
$0.30 per mile when overweight (also when the configuration cannot be licensed in Virginia).

Superload single-trip permits add a damage fee based on gross weight (schedule not published on the DMV pages). Superload status can start below 250,000 lb when axle weights exceed single-trip limits (24,000 single / 44,000 tandem). VDOT engineering analysis cost may also be charged.

restrictions.text: Travel sunrise to sunset. No travel inside city/town corporate limits 7-9 AM and 4-6 PM (except overweight-only or overlength-only up to 85 ft incl. rear overhang).
No travel on New Year's, Memorial Day, July 4, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas: permits invalid from noon the preceding weekday through the holiday (Monday holiday: from noon Friday).
No travel on New Year's, Memorial Day, July 4, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas: permits invalid from noon the preceding weekday through the holiday (Monday holiday: from noon Friday).
No travel when road conditions, visibility or weather make travel hazardous.

travel.note: Sunrise to sunset applies to all permitted loads (24VAC20-82-110 B).

notes: Routine single-trip maximums: 15 ft wide, 15 ft high, 150 ft long, 24,000 lb single / 44,000 lb tandem axle; beyond that is a superload (apply at least 10 working days ahead).

Over 18 ft wide, 250,000 lb, 200 ft long or 16 ft high: a detailed travel plan may be required (police, utility and VDOT authorizations). Loads over 18 ft wide or 200 ft long: escorts set case by case.
Over 400,000 lb: vehicle schematic for VDOT; over 750,000 lb (sometimes 500,000+): applicant-hired Virginia PE structural analysis.
Overweight permits are not valid on Interstates over 80,000 lb except for irreducible loads.
